title: Commensurate Lattice Twisted Interface Builder Parameters
description: Parameters for the commensurate lattice interface builder

max_supercell_matrix_int.description: The maximum integer for the transformation matrices. If not provided, it will be determined based on the target angle and the lattice vectors automatically.

limit_max_int.description: The limit for the maximum integer for the transformation matrices when searching

angle_tolerance.description: The tolerance for the angle between the commensurate lattices and the target angle, in degrees.

return_first_match.description: Whether to return the first match or all matches.
